_comment: EXT-63 SMOKE, arm 8 — arm 4 (rxcb) with SH degree 8 -> 15.  THE DEFECT-2 DISCRIMINATOR.
THE ONE VARIABLE: estimation.global_vtec_sh.max_degree 8 -> 15.  Layer 2 stays at
degree 4, kaula_scale_tecu stays 10, q_per_degree stays 0.01, representation sigma
stays 5.0 — same single-knob convention as _ft63_pdfix_qz0_deg15.json on this root.
DEFECT 2: every EXT-CB arm ignites a00 at ~12.7 TECU where the COD GIM's area-weighted
global mean is 32.24 and the W6 self-contained control ignites 23.1 -> 28.7 and holds.
The only structural difference left: the control has 32 free satellite code-bias states,
EXT-CB has none.  Leading reading (project_network_code_bias_scope: our DCBs vs COD's
correlate 0.67, rms 1.16 m): the free satellite DCBs have been absorbing the deg-8 SH
representation error; pin them to COD and the error lands in the field level.
PREDICTION (stated before the run):
- If the reading is RIGHT, a richer surface shrinks the representation error and the
ignition level moves materially up from 12.78 toward the ~20-26 band the deg-15
single-layer self-contained control ignites in (agu63_nolane_d15_30ep: 20.7 -> 25.7,
Kaula ratios <= ~1, healthy at 61 sta).  Full recovery to 32 is NOT required — deg-15
still has representation error — but the move must be well outside the ~0.2 TECU
arm-to-arm scatter (dual/triple/el10 all ignite 12.6-12.8).
- If a00 stays ~12.7, degree is not the lever and DEFECT 2 is an S-BASIS OFFSET in the
GF chain (rx-DCB common-mode convention vs COD's receiver-group-delay-in-clock
convention, or a bias-application defect upstream), not representation error.
ALIASING WATCH (the pdfix deg-15 card's failure mode, outside the POSTURE ledger's
n_sta >= 150 envelope deliberately): kaula_ratio_deg9..15 sitting >> 1 means the fine
degrees are eating unmodeled signal, and the a00 band is where it shows first.  256
layer-1 coefficients against ~370-380 LOS/epoch is ~1.5 LOS per coefficient — thin;
the Kaula prior is the only regularizer above the data's resolving power.
20 epochs is inside ignition: LEVEL read + wiring only, no settled-science claim.
